purpose: エリア画面の連続シーン背景。3ホットスポット（①調査ポイント ~18%左, ②下水処理場 ~52%, ③設計事務所/川岸 ~80%）
scene: A gentle town river seen as one continuous miniature clay diorama, left to right: a riverside survey point where a tiny researcher in waders holds a water bottle by a reed bank; a small tidy sewage treatment plant with round aeration tanks and bubbles, connected to the river by a clean outfall; a bright riverside office with a drawing board and, beside it, a stretch of bank being reworked with stones, one small fish ladder at a low weir. Clear day, blue-green water with visible riffles, dragonflies. Cozy handcrafted clay look, tiny figures, hopeful mood.
composition: Wide horizontal scene, slight high angle, the river flowing left to right through the whole image. Three work areas at roughly 18%/52%/80% width. At least 8% empty margin at both edges. Sky top 20%.
required_objects: reed bank with a tiny surveyor
low weir with a small fish ladder
